title: Call for EOIs: Financing Universal Energy Access across Latin America and the Caribbean
desc: Deadline: 09-Sep-2026 The Universal Access Coalition Financing Facility supports projects that expand reliable, affordable, and sustainable electricity access across Latin America and the Caribbean. The facility offers technical assistance grants of US$100,000 to US$400,000 and investment financing of US$200,000 to US$750,000 for scalable energy-access projects serving underserved communities.
